nurse.text: Hello, pet! Welcome to the Carlisle Sanctuary. Sit by the radiator. It was installed in 1974 and it has never once been wrong about the weather.
What can we do for you?

then.text: Rest awhile. There's tea in the pot and a rock cake that has, I'm afraid, lived up to its name. Your team is in good hands.
They're good as new. Off you go now, and take a waterproof. Take two. Take the hat with the bobble.
The Ark? It's through there, by the kettle. If it starts to hum, that's the tea; if it starts to hiss, that's the computer.

else.text: No bother. Pop in whenever you're soaked. Which is whenever.
